title: Button
description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A button with a click handler. All native <button> attributes are forwarded.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Use variant to communicate the intent of the action.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Four sizes: small, medium (default), large and xlarge.

shapes.title: Shapes and radius
shapes.description: Preset shapes, or a custom borderRadius preset / pixel value.

states.title: States
states.description: Loading, disabled and active states. Loading blocks clicks while an action is running.

with-icon.title: With icons
with-icon.description: Combine text and icons. Give icon-only buttons an ariaLabel.

ButtonProps.onClick: Called when the button is clicked (not called while disabled)
ButtonProps.ariaLabel: Accessible label, required when the button only contains an icon
ButtonProps.loading: Shows a spinner and blocks interaction
ButtonProps.active: Renders the button in its pressed/active state
ButtonProps.borderRadius: Corner radius: a preset or a number of pixels
